answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks collateral on a public ledge, and peers attest only after sustained, verifiable work. Creating a new identity costs a fresh bond plus the reputational history it cannot fake, so mass fake accounts become expensive. A falcon circling overhead never sees the hidden duplicates; honest agents simply wander between tasks, their stake and attestations following them.
